Let’s talk about BONDS✨ one of the simplest ways to explore fixed-income investing.

When you buy a bond, you’re essentially lending money to a company or government, and in return, you receive interest for a predetermined period. Depending on the bond, interest payments can be monthly, quarterly or annually.

What I like about bonds is that you can see important details like returns, tenure and payment dates upfront, helping you understand what you’re investing in before you invest.

I use Wint Wealth to explore bonds, where you can start investing from ₹10,000.

Investments in bonds are subject to risks. Returns are not guaranteed and may vary depending on the investment.

🚨 Trick that I follow to get fixed 11% returns !

While everyone chases stocks, many investors use bonds to earn predictable returns with lower volatility. Certain corporate bonds can offer yields close to 11%, paying regular interest regardless of daily market swings.

The key is understanding credit risk and choosing quality issuers. For investors seeking steady cash flow, bonds can be a powerful alternative to relying solely on stock market gains.
